an5.75:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ekacco yodhājīvo rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:1.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ.
an5.75:2.2: api ca kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:2.3: evarūpo’pi kho bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:2.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ,
an5.75:3.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:3.3: evarūpo’pi kho bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:3.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ.
an5.75:4.2: api ca kho sampahāre āhaññati, vyāpajjati.
an5.75:4.3: evarūpo’pi kho bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:4.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ, sahati sampahāraṃ.
an5.75:5.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an5.75:5.3: evarūpo’pi kho bhikkhave idhekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:5.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo yodhājīvo. santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:5.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:6.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, pañcayodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā. bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:6.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu rajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:6.7: ‘asukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā’ti.
an5.75:6.8: so taṃ sutvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:7.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, yodhājīvo rajaggaṃ disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
an5.75:7.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ.
an5.75:8.2: api ca kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati. na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:8.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na heva kho suṇāti:
an5.75:8.6: ‘asukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā’ti.
an5.75:8.7: api ca kho sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ.
an5.75:8.8: so taṃ disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati. na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:9.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ,
an5.75:9.2: api ca kho dhajaggaññeva disvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:9.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ
an5.75:10.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:10.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati, ullapati, ujjhagghati, uppaṇḍeti.
an5.75:10.6: so mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjhagghiyamāno uppaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ.
an5.75:11.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ,
an5.75:11.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:11.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ.
an5.75:12.2: api ca kho sampahāre āhaññati vyāpajjati.
an5.75:12.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati, abhinipajjati, ajjhottharati.
an5.75:12.5: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhottariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvīkatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patisevati.
an5.75:13.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ, api ca kho sampahāre āhaññati, vyāpajjati,
an5.75:13.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave, catuttho yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:14.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ, sahati sampahāraṃ. so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo, tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an5.75:14.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati, abhinipajjati, ajjhottharati.
an5.75:14.4: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno viniveṭhetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
an5.75:14.5: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
an5.75:15.1: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an5.75:15.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.3: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī. vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno. thīnamiddhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.7: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an5.75:16.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte …pe… āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
an5.75:16.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an5.75:16.3: ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an5.75:16.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an5.75:16.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
an5.75:17.1: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave, yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, sahati dhajaggaṃ, sahati ussādanaṃ, sahati sampahāraṃ, so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an5.75:17.4: ayaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:17.5: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsū’ti.
